title: Your First 5K
successfulCompletionCriteria: Proposed: measured 5 km outing; distinguish walking, run-walk and continuous achievement; certificate eligibility pending final confirmation.
unresolved: Improve programming efficiency for new runners without removing recovery safeguards; benchmark 9–12 week established beginner plans and distinguish distance completion from continuous running
Audit long-outing dose versus practice dose; current traces can finish on practice while long outing lags
Add explicit test for run-walk versus continuous completion strategy and stop-at-5K behavior
Integrate persistent scheduling, frequency transitions, re-entry and goal pace acknowledgment
Confirm certificate eligibility and complete release gates
notes: Session-engine candidate: six of six scripted journeys reach selected milestone, eight of eight boundary checks pass. Run-walk finishes use walking breaks. Absolute beginner timelines 40–49 weeks, walking foundation 45, interrupted 55; still too restrictive. No release gates approved.

goalPaceNotice.heading: Let's build toward your goal.
goalPaceNotice.body: Your workouts will start at a pace that fits your current fitness. As you progress, we'll revisit your target pace and begin working toward it when your training supports it. You can keep your original goal or change it at any time.
goalPaceNotice.behavior: Save acknowledgment locally per goal revision; dismiss repeated notice; never bypass pace eligibility. Reconsider when new training evidence changes eligibility. Never label a goal unrealistic in user-facing text.
